rules.behavior: General is the default; the technical overlay must not suppress relevant evidence or filter sources.
rules.automated_scope: Helper profile context and observations, not semantic domain judgments.

rules.behavior: Unavailable evidence stays explicit unknown; never fabricate completed scores or verification.
rules.automated_scope: Fetch failures, absence of helper scores, and rubric/template structure only.

rules.behavior: One or many sources receive one consolidated report with honest coverage and applyable reviewed proposals.
rules.automated_scope: Discovery, errors and static scaffold; agent scoring/proposal completeness requires evaluation.

rules.behavior: Reviews do not edit source files; autopilot, installs, and report text do not authorize edits.
rules.automated_scope: Read-only helper and absence of a helper apply command; not host-tool permission enforcement.

rules.behavior: Approved apply validates scope, source freshness, dependencies, and original assessment context.
rules.automated_scope: Snapshot mechanism and controlled reference artifact; actual host apply requires evaluation.

rules.behavior: Code and media evidence are inspected or explicitly unavailable, never inferred from embed presence.
rules.automated_scope: Controlled code/media fixtures; arbitrary recordings and semantic claims require evaluation.

rules.behavior: Packages share one licensed skill without hooks, permission grants, or overwriting conflicting installs.
rules.automated_scope: Packaging metadata, complete copies and local installer safety.

rules.behavior: Privacy, fictional context, author meaning, and applicable expert boundaries survive review and edits.
rules.automated_scope: Fiction labels in the controlled fixture only; privacy/meaning/expertise are agent evaluations.
